Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to lock in a joint Exec QBR + product demo that covers: a short executive intro (10m), a technical demo showing typical throughput/latency and secure deployment options (30m), and a brief procurement/contract next-steps review (20m). Total: 60 minutes.

Proposed time slots (PST):
- Tues 11/17 10:00–11:00
- Wed 11/18 13:00–14:00
- Fri 11/20 09:00–10:00

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan (Redwood_MAPP_v1.pdf) that outlines who does what before/after the meeting.

Can you confirm which slot works and who from Integro needs to be on the call (procurement, legal, security, lead eng)? If procurement needs PO language in advance or SOC2 evidence, call that out and we’ll surface it before the meeting.

Looping in our SE Dylan Brooks and AM Marissa Cole to support the demo and contract path — and our VP sponsor Evelyn Hart (cc'd) to join the QBR portion. Karthik Iyer will be on standby for any deep infra questions.

Best,

Hi Ben —

Thanks — appreciate the plan. Quick notes from our side:
- Procurement (James) needs to be on the call to confirm commercial steps; he prefers an agenda that calls out procurement review explicitly.
- Security (Anna) will want a short technical pre-call (15–20m) to validate SOC2/TSC controls before the QBR/demo. She asked whether you can provide SOC2 type II report or a pointer to where we can get relevant artifacts.
- Our lead engineer (me) will attend the demo; please include a link to a short architecture diagram in advance.

Of the proposed slots, none of those three work for James (travel). Can we shift to the week after? Open windows for our exec team:
- Mon 11/23 10:00–11:00 (PST)
- Tue 11/24 14:00–15:00 (PST)

If moving a week breaks anything on your side, let us know — otherwise prefer to pick one of the two above. I’m attaching Integro's security questionnaire response (filled) so your team can review prior to Anna's pre-call.

Thanks,

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the security questionnaire. I’ve reviewed the doc and shared it with our security SMEs; we can provide a SOC2 Type II report and a short artifact bundle (audit scope, retention policy, access controls) ahead of the pre-call. Dylan, can you please prepare a 15-minute technical pre-brief for Anna and her team?

To keep momentum, I’ve updated the mutual action plan and attached it (mutual-action-plan.xlsx). Proposed next steps:
- Week-of 11/23: Security tech pre-call (15–20m) with Anna + Redwood SE.
- Tue 11/24 14:00–15:00 PST: Exec QBR + Demo (60m) with VP sponsor + procurement + product + eng.
- Provide SOC2 + artifact bundle by 11/18 so Anna has time to review.

If that timeline works, I’ll send a calendar invite and DocuSign SOW to James for review (we can do Net 30 + standard SLAs; we’ll attach a redlineable SOW).

- Please share a short architecture diagram (network boundaries, data flow) and a list of where customer data is encrypted at rest (KMS/HSM notes).
